sections.subhead: Rebuild or Replatform Your Store Without Losing the Google Rankings You Already Earned

body.html: Ecommerce Redesign & Migration Kochi — a complete store overhaul, a move to a different platform, or both together, handled so the traffic and search rankings you have already built come with you. Teknoppy rebuilds underperforming stores and moves them between WooCommerce, Shopify and custom platforms with products, customer accounts and order history intact.

Most stores lose rankings during a replatform for one avoidable reason: the old URLs are dropped without a redirect map, and every product page that used to rank starts returning a 404. We map that before a single page is rebuilt, so ecommerce migration services Kochi work protects your SEO equity rather than resetting it.

sections.h2: What Our Ecommerce Redesign & Migration Includes

items.title: Full Store Redesign
items.html: A rebuild of the parts of the store customers actually use — product pages, category browsing, cart and checkout — laid out around how people shop today rather than around the limits of the original template.

items.title: Platform Migration
items.html: Moving your store between platforms — WooCommerce, Shopify, a custom build or a multi-vendor marketplace — with the catalogue, customer accounts and order history carried across rather than re-entered by hand.

items.title: SEO Equity & Redirect Mapping
items.html: Every indexed URL is inventoried and mapped to its new address before launch, so ranked product and category pages redirect cleanly instead of returning a 404 on the day you go live.

items.title: Payments, Shipping & Data Testing
items.html: Gateways, tax rules, shipping zones and stock levels are reconfigured on the new platform and tested with real transaction flows before the store is switched over.

items.title: Store & Traffic Audit
items.text: We review your current store, its analytics and its ranking pages to establish what is working and must be preserved — not only what needs replacing.

items.title: URL & Redirect Mapping
items.text: Every indexed URL is listed and mapped to its destination on the new store. That map is agreed before design work starts, rather than improvised on launch day.

items.title: Design & Rebuild
items.text: The storefront is redesigned and rebuilt on the chosen platform, with product pages, navigation and checkout scoped to your real catalogue.

items.title: Data & Payment Migration
items.text: Products, variants, images, customer accounts and order history are moved across, then gateways, tax and shipping rules are reconfigured and tested end to end.

items.title: Launch & Post-Migration Monitoring
items.text: The store goes live with redirects active and a fresh sitemap submitted, and we monitor crawl errors, rankings and checkout through the weeks that follow.

sections.h2: Why Choose Teknoppy for Ecommerce Redesign & Migration in Kochi

items.html: Redirects are mapped before the rebuild, not after it. The most common cause of lost traffic after a replatform is an unmapped URL, so the redirect plan is part of the scope from day one.

We work across every platform we build on. WooCommerce, Shopify, custom and multi-vendor — so the recommendation you get is about what suits your store, not about the one platform we happen to prefer.
Your order history and customer accounts come with you. Migration covers the data your business actually runs on, not just the product list.
A Kochi-based team through the launch window. The weeks after a migration are when problems surface — you reach the developers who did the work, not a support queue routed overseas.

outro.text: A redesign and a migration are often needed together: a store that has outgrown its platform has usually also outgrown the design it launched with. Scoping them as one project avoids paying to rebuild the same pages twice, and keeps a single redirect map covering both the new structure and the new platform.

sections.intro: This service fits businesses that are:

items.text: Running a store that looks dated or converts poorly, where the checkout and product pages are quietly losing sales
Outgrowing a hosted platform's limits, or paying per-sale fees that no longer make sense at current order volume
Sitting on a store built by someone unreachable, with no documentation and no safe way to make changes
Planning a rebrand or catalogue restructure that will change most of the store's existing URLs

outro.html: If you are moving specifically onto WordPress, see WooCommerce Development; for a move onto a hosted platform, see Shopify Development. If the rebuild needs functionality no platform offers off the shelf, Custom Ecommerce Development is the closer fit.

sections.h2: Ecommerce Redesign & Migration Projects We've Delivered

paragraphs.html: Teknoppy has rebuilt and replatformed stores for retail, D2C and export brands across Kochi and Kerala, each with its own catalogue structure, payment setup and ranking history to carry across. See the builds in our Ecommerce Projects Portfolio.

Ecommerce redesign and migration projects typically fall between Rs. 50,000 and Rs. 2,00,000, depending on catalogue size, how many URLs need mapping, and whether the platform is changing as well as the design. Every project receives a written quote before work begins — use our Website Cost Calculator or Request a Quote.

sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — Ecommerce Redesign & Migration Kochi

items.q: Will we lose our Google rankings when we migrate?
items.a: Not if the migration is planned properly. Rankings are lost when old URLs disappear without redirects. We inventory every indexed URL and map it to its new address before launch, so ranked pages pass their equity to the new store instead of returning a 404. Some short-term fluctuation while Google re-crawls the site is normal; a permanent drop is not.

items.q: Can you move our store from Shopify to WooCommerce, or the other way around?
items.a: Yes, in both directions, as well as from custom and legacy stores. Products, variants, images, customer accounts and order history are moved across, and payment, tax and shipping rules are rebuilt and tested on the new platform before switch-over.

items.q: Will our store be offline during the migration?
items.a: No. The new store is built and tested on a staging environment while your current store keeps selling. The switch-over happens only once everything is verified, which normally means minutes of downtime rather than days.

items.q: Do we have to redesign the store in order to migrate it?
items.a: No — a migration can carry your existing design across where it still works. In practice most stores ready to replatform are also ready for a redesign, so we scope both and you decide. Doing them together avoids rebuilding the same pages twice.

items.q: What happens to our existing customer accounts and order history?
items.a: They come with you. Customer records and past orders are migrated so support, returns and repeat-purchase data stay intact. Passwords generally cannot be transferred between platforms for security reasons, so customers are asked to reset theirs on first login.

items.q: How long does an ecommerce redesign or migration take?
items.a: Most projects run 4 to 8 weeks from audit to launch, depending on catalogue size and how many URLs need mapping. A platform change combined with a full redesign, or a very large catalogue, takes longer — you receive a written timeline after the audit rather than a generic estimate upfront.

sections.h2: Ready to Rebuild or Replatform Your Store?

paragraphs.text: A store that is slow, dated, or stuck on the wrong platform costs you sales every day it stays that way — and a badly handled migration costs you the rankings on top. Teknoppy's Ecommerce Redesign & Migration Kochi team maps the redirects first, moves your data across intact, and monitors the store through launch.
